name: Weather Cell Climatology
description: Durable per-grid-cell calendar-week climatology cache, built once ever per cell from the ERA5 year files (1940-2021 subsample) on the cell's first evaluation. normals_json holds the 52 weekly normals (precipitation weekly-sum median/p75/p90/p99 and TCWV weekly mean/std) consumed by warnings_engine/climatology.py for the optional seasonal-anomaly context. Deleting a row simply triggers a rebuild on the next evaluation. All datetimes are UTC.

fields.label: Grid Key
fields.description: Grid-rounded "lat,lng" at 0.25 degree resolution - same key as the Weather Watch Location name

fields.label: Years Sampled
fields.description: Number of climatology years sampled from the 1940-2021 ERA5 year files

fields.label: Weekly Normals (JSON)
fields.description: JSON schema v1: {version, latitude, longitude, years_sampled, source, computed_at, weeks: [{week 0..51, precip_mm: {n, median, p75, p90, p99} | null, tcwv: {n, mean, std} | null}]}. Admin/debug only - never sent to clients.
